title: Lower bound for maximum influence
statement:
Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the discrete cube, and suppose its variance is positive. For $0<\delta<1$, define $\rho=(1-\delta)/(1+\delta)$. Then
\[
\rho^{-1/\delta}\left(\frac{I(f)}{\operatorname{Var}(f)}\right)^{-1/\delta}\rho^{I(f)/(\delta\operatorname{Var}(f))}\leq \max_i \operatorname{Inf}_i(f),
\]
where $I(f)$ is the total influence and $\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)$ is the influence of coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the finite discrete cube
